dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible high-contrast 'O' and 'C' shaped structures characterized by thin, high-intensity perimeters. These structures exhibit a sharp gradient transition from high-intensity borders to low-intensity (darker) internal centers, with several overlapping to form complex multi-lobed shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters; most high-intensity pixel concentrations are confined to the thin, linear perimeters of the macro-annuli. A higher density of localized low-intensity (solid dark) spots is visible in the gaps between the ring structures on the lower lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper mid-dorsal region form an obtuse triangle. A series of four smaller annuli centroids along the mid-lateral axis form a roughly linear geometric sequence.
